case_review.content_policy: Tracked artifacts contain opaque local-review IDs only. Real restricted IDs, source text, rankings, and per-query metrics remain in a gitignored local research-only mapping and are never public-exported.
case_review.disagreement: Per track select exactly six queries by descending across-model range of best positive rank, treating a missing positive in top 100 as rank 101; then descending count of model pairs that disagree on Recall@10; then canonical query ID ascending.
case_review.failure: After removing disagreement queries, per track select exactly six by ascending cross-model mean nDCG@10; then descending number of models with zero nDCG@10; then ascending mean Recall@100; then canonical query ID ascending.

slices.definition: Lowercase strip the canonical query text and count Unicode word tokens with (?u)\b\w+\b.
slices.limitations: Track-local descriptive slice; thresholds cannot be changed after scores are observed.
slices.sample_rule: No cross-track pooling. n=0 is NA; n=1-9 reports point estimates only with no CI or win claim; n>=10 uses 10000 paired bootstrap samples with seed 20260826. Never merge bins.

slices.definition: For each positive document compute |unique lowercase Unicode query tokens intersect unique document tokens| / |unique query tokens| and use the maximum across positives.
slices.limitations: Measures surface token overlap, not semantic overlap; positive texts stay local and restricted.
slices.sample_rule: No cross-track pooling. n=0 is NA; n=1-9 reports point estimates only with no CI or win claim; n>=10 uses 10000 paired bootstrap samples with seed 20260826. Never merge bins.

slices.definition: Count lowercase Unicode word tokens for every positive document and bin each query by the median positive-document token count.
slices.limitations: Canonical word-token length is not the model tokenizer length and does not directly identify truncation.
slices.sample_rule: No cross-track pooling. n=0 is NA; n=1-9 reports point estimates only with no CI or win claim; n>=10 uses 10000 paired bootstrap samples with seed 20260826. Never merge bins.

slices.definition: Count unique canonical positive qrel document IDs per query after canonical materialization validation.
slices.limitations: Qrel density reflects annotation multiplicity and is not corpus prevalence.
slices.sample_rule: No cross-track pooling. n=0 is NA; n=1-9 reports point estimates only with no CI or win claim; n>=10 uses 10000 paired bootstrap samples with seed 20260826. Never merge bins.
